meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides TechnoBase.FM's shop slider, app badges and log-in prompts; blur pictures; hide track list, counts
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, real Chrome (headless) on www.technobase.fm (home) with iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA, DOM captured after 7 seconds. The site is in German. Fixtures `real.html` and `desktop-real.html` are sanitised excerpts (text stripped, needed ancestors only, `data-keep` on the main content, the login menu and the stream bar).

LIVE (same on both captures): `.module-box.w107` 1 (the home slider), `.footer-menu-right.apps` 1, `.only-for-members` 1, `.not-loggin-in-text` 6, `#content img` 20, `#right-box img` 7 (the sidebar sits inside #content, so 20 in total), `.module-box.w156` 1 (Trackliste), `.module-box.w129` 1 (Zuhörer counts), `.module-box.w112` 1 (Nächste Show). The original cookie, ad and app-banner rules matched nothing on the home page.

Choices: Pictures Show/Blur/Hide; Track list Show/Dim/Hide.

The `.module-box.wNNN` hooks are Joomla module ids: stable while the site keeps the same modules, but an admin renumbering a module would break one rule; the German text of the boxes is never used by a rule. The player lives in `#aside-menu` / `#streambar` and is never touched.

NOT verified: the greetings and wishes pop-up, the shop, articles, the logged-in site, and the HouseTime, HardBase and TranceBase sister sites (their module ids may differ; they are not in this recipe's match list).
